description: Five short scenes in one lit ice cave with a flat floor, a raised shelf and a low ceiling in places. Tux walks, waits and jumps while hopping and walking creatures, a bomb creature and things hanging from the ceiling act around him; several of the outcomes do not follow the game's usual rules.
reproduces: https://github.com/SuperTux/supertux/issues/1175#issuecomment-767042344 (Tux grazes a spike edge and dies despite being only marginally touching it)
scenario: Base commit plus the task's injected defects, five scripted scenes in a custom ice-cave level, recorded headless (Xvfb) at 800x500 and scaled to 1280x800, 24 fps.
